Issue Title: [BUG] Opaque Pydantic error when ToolContext is provided with mismatched parameter name

### Strands Version

1.11.0

3.13.3

### Operating System

macOs 15.6.1

### Installation Method

pip

# test.py
from strands import Agent, tool, ToolContext

@tool(context=True)
def test(context: ToolContext) -> dict:
